summary: Short flag-gated selector over an __int16 input: with flag bit 0x4 set it returns a1 | 0x3F, with flag bit 0x8 set it returns a1 & 0xC0, otherwise returns the flag byte unchanged.

local_names.result: value returned on the default path

operations.description: result = a2 stores the input flag byte as the default return value.
return a1 | 0x3F when flag bit 0x4 is set (forces low 6 bits).
return a1 & 0xC0 when flag bit 0x8 is set (masks to high 2 bits).
return result (the unmodified flag byte a2) when neither flag bit is set.

unresolved: Meaning of flag bits 0x4 and 0x8 unknown; the caller list spans AI, scene, wheel, engine, camera and audio subsystems, so the two transform paths likely serve different consumers.
Return-width mismatch in the raw source (char result but __int16-derived returns) is a decompiler artifact; real width unresolved.
Why the default path returns the flag byte rather than a1 is unclear.
